status: planned expected cases; not executed certification

cases.name: Idiomatic comparison with t.Errorf
cases.rationale: Failure methods need not execute in a passing Go test.

cases.name: Aliased testify import
cases.rationale: Import identity survives local renaming.

cases.name: Local object named require
cases.rationale: A matching local name is not an assertion-library identity.

cases.name: Direct local assertion helper
cases.rationale: Resolve a direct local call within the declared package boundary.

cases.name: Two-level helper chain
cases.rationale: Support bounded ordinary composition without a one-level false positive.

cases.name: Recursive helper cycle
cases.rationale: Resolution must terminate and disclose incomplete proof.

cases.name: Same helper name in different packages
cases.rationale: One package cannot borrow another package helper assertion.

cases.name: Three subtests with one logging-only body
cases.rationale: Locate the nonasserting body independently of its siblings.

cases.name: Parent only organizes subtests
cases.rationale: A parent orchestration body need not duplicate child assertions.

cases.name: TestMain lifecycle hook
cases.rationale: Lifecycle setup is not an ordinary assertion-bearing test.

cases.name: Registered subprocess helper
cases.rationale: The parent owns exit-code and output assertions.

cases.name: Unregistered process-like helper
cases.rationale: Do not infer a privileged exemption from a suggestive name.

cases.name: Conditional t.Skip with available toolchain
cases.rationale: A source call does not prove the case was skipped.

cases.name: Unconditional skip-only placeholder
cases.rationale: A placeholder has no implemented behavior after the skip.

cases.name: NoError-only happy-path test
cases.rationale: Successful input does not prove a negative case.

cases.name: Invalid keyword in unreachable branch
cases.rationale: Text and unreachable code cannot establish negative-input behavior.

cases.name: Platform-excluded test file
cases.rationale: Assessment respects the declared build context.

cases.name: Unavailable module/type information
cases.rationale: Semantic loading failure cannot become a clean verdict.

cases.name: Explicit compile-contract test
cases.rationale: Compile success can be the declared test contract.

cases.name: Race-focused exercise
cases.rationale: No-panic or race evidence is narrower than output correctness.

cases.name: Direct completed matcher
cases.rationale: Native supported assertions should work without custom scanning.

cases.name: Imported axe-style helper
cases.rationale: Delegated assertion activity is observed by the runner.

cases.name: Empty test
cases.rationale: The supported native profile requires observed assertion activity.

cases.name: Unreachable assertion
cases.rationale: Only executed assertion activity counts.

cases.name: Bare expect without matcher
cases.rationale: The 2.1.9 runtime accepts this; syntax validation must close the gap.

cases.name: Tautological matcher
cases.rationale: An assertion counter cannot prove independent expected behavior.

cases.name: Asserting beforeEach with empty body
cases.rationale: Hook activity can satisfy native assertion requirements.

cases.name: Node assert under Vitest expect-only profile
cases.rationale: A legitimate alternate assertion must not be misdescribed as no assertion.

cases.name: Parameterized case lacking assertion
cases.rationale: Each generated case needs separate runtime attribution.

cases.name: Concurrent local expect context
cases.rationale: Ensure attribution does not leak between concurrent tests.

cases.name: Custom matcher returning failure
cases.rationale: Custom assertions must preserve actual test failure.

cases.name: Failed setup hook
cases.rationale: Setup failure is not a clean or skipped test.

cases.name: Retry passes after failure
cases.rationale: Keep retry history instead of replacing it with the final pass.

cases.name: Skipped case
cases.rationale: A skip never becomes a passing requirement observation.

cases.name: Focused test
cases.rationale: Supported native configuration or lint rejects unintended focus.

cases.name: Assertion words inside string
cases.rationale: A string literal is not an executable call.

cases.name: Extended test function
cases.rationale: Recognize declared extensions without regex guessing.

cases.name: Unawaited asynchronous matcher
cases.rationale: The assertion must participate in test completion.

cases.name: Returned asynchronous assertion
cases.rationale: Returning a promise can be valid completion ownership.

cases.name: Unsupported major version
cases.rationale: Missing compatibility evidence cannot manufacture support.

cases.name: Literal independent expected result
cases.rationale: Literal expected values can be the strongest simple oracle.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: behavioral oracle strength is domain semantics, not a claim available to a declared static Unit Health profile.

cases.name: Imported protocol enum
cases.rationale: Stable contract identifiers can be shared incidentally.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: imported protocol identity requires semantic cross-module review outside the declared static profiles.

cases.name: Expected result computed by production function
cases.rationale: Review common-mode oracle failure; do not claim complete static detection.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: common-mode behavioral adequacy is advisory review evidence, not deterministic static evidence.

cases.name: Fresh deterministic factory
cases.rationale: Defaults remove incidental setup without sharing mutable state.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: factory aliasing requires runtime object identity and mutation evidence.

cases.name: Factory silently repairs invalid override
cases.rationale: The invalid-input reference test must detect normalization that hides its case.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: invalid-input normalization is a behavioral reference assertion outside static profiles.

cases.name: Nested singleton factory object
cases.rationale: Mutating one instance must not affect a second instance.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: nested object aliasing requires runtime identity and mutation evidence.

cases.name: Raw malformed JSON
cases.rationale: Malformed input is intentionally outside valid generated types.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: parser acceptance and generated-type boundaries require a domain parser contract.

cases.name: Serializer-generated parser input only
cases.rationale: Roundtrip tests need independent compatibility cases for shared defects.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: wire compatibility is a semantic interoperability claim, not static source evidence.

cases.name: Justified cardinality assertion
cases.rationale: Count is sufficient when cardinality itself is the contract.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: assertion sufficiency depends on the domain contract, which static analysis cannot infer.

cases.name: Filtering test checks only unexplained length
cases.rationale: Membership and order may be the missing behavioral contract.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: membership and order adequacy require domain semantics beyond static profiles.

cases.name: Typed key in cimode
cases.rationale: Proves key wiring while remaining copy-independent.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: rendered UI and localization state require a UI runtime profile not declared for calibration.

cases.name: Real locale plural and interpolation
cases.rationale: Real translation behavior needs real locale evaluation.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: pluralization and interpolation require executing the localization runtime.

cases.name: Role and accessible name query
cases.rationale: Semantic queries express user-visible control behavior.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: accessibility query behavior requires a rendered UI and interaction runtime.

cases.name: Justified shared test ID
cases.rationale: Some surfaces have no suitable semantic query.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: selector suitability is a UI contract judgment, not static source evidence.

cases.name: Locale leaks across tests
cases.rationale: Each test must receive declared locale state independently.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: locale leakage requires multi-test runtime state observation.

cases.name: Global console suppression
cases.rationale: Unexpected errors must remain visible; suppression requires local rationale.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: console suppression needs runtime output and reviewer context, not a deterministic static rule.

cases.name: UH-CORE-001 actual registry ID
cases.rationale: IDs come from the registry rather than a REQ-prefix regex.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: requirement ownership is an external registry and execution-evidence contract, not a static source profile.

cases.name: Suite-inherited comma-separated tags
cases.rationale: Preserve existing reporter grammar and inheritance.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: inherited requirement tags require the Test Genie reporter and owner registry.

cases.name: ID only in a comment
cases.rationale: A source mention is not an observed passing test.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: execution status is supplied by Test Genie runtime evidence, not static source calibration.

cases.name: Integration-only requirement
cases.rationale: Respect the declared validation kind.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: validation-kind ownership is a requirements registry concern.

cases.name: Unavailable registry
cases.rationale: An unavailable owner cannot be treated as an empty registry.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: owner availability is external Test Genie service-state evidence.

cases.name: Prefix-colliding IDs
cases.rationale: Use exact IDs rather than substring membership.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: exact registry membership requires the live requirements owner.

cases.name: Same command with changed source
cases.rationale: A repair is not evidence of flaky behavior.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: source-revision comparability requires persisted run-history identities.

cases.name: Same source with changed toolchain
cases.rationale: Toolchain changes alter the observation context.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: toolchain-cohort comparability requires runtime history metadata.

cases.name: Comparable pass/fail outcomes
cases.rationale: Report observed variation without proving its cause.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: instability requires comparable repeated runtime outcomes.

cases.name: Infrastructure failure versus assertion failure
cases.rationale: Do not attribute a transport outage to a flaky assertion.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: failure-class separation depends on runtime receipts and infrastructure metadata.

cases.name: Legacy missing evidence identity
cases.rationale: Historical observations remain readable without invented identity.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: legacy evidence identity is a history migration concern, not a static test-quality observation.

cases.name: Malformed source file
cases.rationale: Parse errors must not disappear as no findings.

cases.name: Unreadable source or truncated discovery
cases.rationale: Assessment coverage exposes missing inputs.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: unreadable or truncated discovery is an executor/discovery failure-path contract, not a source calibration profile.

cases.name: File order shuffled
cases.rationale: Semantic result must not depend on directory enumeration order.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: order-independence is a harness determinism property covered by focused tests, not an additional rule observation.

cases.name: Finding limit reached
cases.rationale: Truncation must retain totals and detail retrieval.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: finding pagination and totals are response-contract behavior covered by API tests.

cases.name: Denied external network on supported host
cases.rationale: The declared profile needs an actual denial observation.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: network denial requires a disposable execution sandbox and receipt.

cases.name: Unsupported host sandbox
cases.rationale: Do not silently replace isolation with network allow.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: host capability refusal is environment-specific executor evidence.

cases.name: Local streaming integration
cases.rationale: Real loopback transport is valid for transport behavior.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: loopback transport behavior requires an integration runtime and lifecycle receipt.

cases.name: Wrong production threshold
cases.rationale: A selected behavioral fault must reach the expected failing assertion.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: mutation killing is a disposable runtime experiment, not static calibration evidence.

cases.name: Mutant does not compile
cases.rationale: Build failure does not prove the test detects behavior.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: mutation compilation validity is an experiment-runner result.

cases.name: Equivalent or out-of-contract mutant
cases.rationale: A survivor is not automatically a missing-test defect.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: equivalent and out-of-contract dispositions require mutation receipts and contract review.

cases.name: Unavailable target during inventory
cases.rationale: Every discovered target remains in the denominator.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: fleet denominator behavior depends on live discovery inventory and target availability.

cases.name: Custom profile migration
cases.rationale: Migration must not overwrite legitimate local test-kind policy.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: profile migration is a control-plane configuration operation.

cases.name: Repeated migration request
cases.rationale: Replaying an acknowledged application must not duplicate changes.
cases.retired_reason: Retired: migration idempotence belongs to the fleet control-plane handler and API tests.

cases.name: Shared Go test utility root with consumers
cases.rationale: A shared internal/testutil package with a helper and co-located consumers must not produce TEST_UTIL_MISSING.
